description:
Universal provider proxy for OpenAI Codex and Claude Code.

opencodex is a universal provider proxy for OpenAI Codex, Claude Code, Claude Desktop, and Grok Build: a local proxy that lets them run on many different LLM providers from a single port, translating between API wire formats.

Features:
- Works with Anthropic, Google, xAI, Groq, OpenRouter, Azure, DeepSeek, Ollama, and 40+ other built-in providers.
- Supports streaming, tool calls, reasoning, and images.
- Handles OAuth logins and a ChatGPT account pool.
- Native model picker in the Codex app, sub-agents, and search/vision sidecars.
Published to npm as @bitkyc08/opencodex@2.100.11 with dist-tag latest.
New Features
- Add macOS menu bar-only mode (#9124)
- Show interrupted WebSocket response delivery (#9136)
- Expand seeded models and allow Claude models (#9192)
- Relay Codex host tools and multimodal conversation history (#9193)
- Add external client MCP integration, stability fixes, and 12-locale UI copy (carry #8884) (#9189)
Bug Fixes
- Use the selected Codex pool account network route (#9129)
- Preserve numeric-looking YAML strings (#9158)
- Use body prompt_cache_key as session_id when no session header is sent (#9145)
- Keep the sidecar web_search prefix during routed compaction (#9173)
- Recognize Traditional Chinese Task Scheduler states (#9160)
- Order per-key, conversation and profile indexes by time (#9103) (#9111)
- Show non-zero DeepSeek balance wallets across currencies (#9153)
- Mask terminal diagnostics while preserving completion output (#9060)
- Bound inline inputs on the xAI edit relay (#9116)
- Require current user text to start a conversation (#9117)
- Complete restart recovery and retry scheduled disconnect handoff (#9135)
- Surface Codex Desktop env_key shim-bypass caveat for Hub-connected clients (#9180)
- Collapse macOS native tray popover on toggle click (#9183)
- Hold active turn capacity through content delivery (#9156)
- Refuse DeepSeek native tool-call markup printed as text (#9194)
- Do not bake Claude Desktop's picker egress proxy into the service definition (#9190)
- Patch Kimi's config.toml in place instead of rewriting it (#9196)
- Keep the main hard-lock refusal when a pool account refuses the model (#9186)
- Opt-in classical TLS groups for hosts that reset on the 1.4.x ClientHello (#9197)
- Preserve leap-second HTTP dates (#9195)
- Check the stored revision on dashboard Combo saves (#9126)
- Bound Claude settings reads during status and preview (#9130)
- Show local-update guidance instead of Update for Windows npm Children (#9181)
- Keep the checkpoint prefix during routed compaction (#9187)
- Advance on the undeclared-tool guard refusal without cooling the target (#9188)
- Warn on a foreground start when the managed service is not serving (#9198)
- Stop advertising native models the proxy cannot route (#9191)
- Price native Ultrafast requests at the published Ultrafast rate (#9178)
- Fix Windows foreground advisory test launcher (#9201)
Documentation
- Point operators to the next inspection (#9155)
- Sync adapter and reference updates (#9179)
Chores
- Update Hono to 4.13.23 and clear MCP transport advisories (#9177)
